title: Check the ending substring
description: Write a function `ends_with_check(text, suffix)` that returns whether `text` ends with `suffix`. Remember `str` methods are case-sensitive.
examples:
ends_with_check('Coding For All', 'All')
-> True
ends_with_check('Coding For All', 'coding')
-> False
hints: text.endswith(suffix) is the mirror of startswith() - it checks the tail of the string. Like every other string method here, it's case-sensitive: 'coding' and 'Coding' don't match.
expected_behavior: Returns True if text ends with suffix (case-sensitive), False otherwise.
explanation: The source question asks whether 'Coding For All' ends with 'coding' (lowercase) - since string comparisons are case-sensitive, that's False even though the letters match.
